prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a text-free illustration plate for an existing vintage comic book cover on a movie-picker website called The Bijou. Create a vertical 5:7 illustration, richly hand-inked and lithographically printed like an American newsstand science-fiction comic circa 1948–1962, with the densely engraved chiaroscuro and dramatic composition of a retro illustrated movie one-sheet. Subject: a large red atomic-age cigar rocket, with silver riveted hull, golden portholes and fins, soaring diagonally from lower left toward upper right; a sweeping golden exhaust ribbon curls around a huge golden ringed planet in the upper right; a smaller saucer, tiny stars, ominous red concentric space swirls, jagged lunar mountains in the lower foreground, and a small distant city silhouette at the bottom. Hero artwork occupies the middle and lower two thirds. Leave the TOP 30 PERCENT as dark near-black space with restrained red arcs, for a separate live-text masthead; no typography whatsoever. Color palette tightly limited to ink black #0d0c0d, hero red #dc2a24, aged cream #f2eddd, golden mustard #d3bc2c, peach #ebba8a and sepia #5b4b3c. Draw convincing dimensional volume with tapered nib hatching, coarse Ben-Day dots and solid shadow shapes, visible paper fibers, slight offset color registration, restrained faded ink and edge scuffs. It should feel like an actual beautifully illustrated found pulp cover, NOT clean vector art, NOT a flat cartoon, NOT 3D, NOT a photograph. Full bleed, no external border, no text, no letters, no watermarks.
